text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read and analyse text in a useful way. For example, NLP makes it possible for computers to translate words from one language into another. It can also perform sentiment analysis, which means finding out whether a piece of writing is positive, negative or neutral. Another common use is chatbots, which are computer programs that can talk with people online. Thanks to NLP, these systems can answer questions and give helpful information. Today, NLP is used in many everyday tools, such as search engines and virtual assistants.
